ABOUT THE AUTHOR: Born in Bowraville NSW, Allen Gillon qualified as a
Teacher for the NSW Department Of Education in 1964, spending almost 25 years as a Primary Teacher. During that time Mr Gillon completed additional courses in musical arrangement at Sydney Conservatorium Of Music. He has written and had published a number of classroom texts, currently in use in
Australian Schools. His musical training and experience resulted in his being granted many play and drama assignments, including a huge production of “Oliver” in the Penrith Department Region in 1977, co-ordinating 3 Primary schools, a 250 piece choir and a 13 member orchestra. Mr Gillon’s love of writing and school performances led him to write and produce many plays.
Public acceptance and the success of these plays led to the production of this publication.

ACT 1 Scene1 Curtains open - prisoners in chains with sledge hammers - some busting rocks - others preparing chow - some getting mush on a plate - choir singing “Chain Gang” - Guards and prisoners choreographed with the music.
Song fades, dinner bell rings as guards push prisoners into line for water.
BLUEY: (Looking at his hands - loud whisper) Hey Shifty! We gotta get outa this place... I’m getting blisters on my blisters!
SHIFTY: Shhhh!! You wanna get us more rocks to bust.
BLUEY: Well what happened to...
SHIFTY: (Indicating Guard coming over to them) Shhhh!!
GUARD: Get in line and shut up you two. (Prisoners shuffle into position)
BLUEY: (As Guard walks away) What happened to our gang, Boss? They were supposed to bust us out last week.
SHIFTY: (As they walk away from water line with their mugs) Don’t know. They said they would be coming over the wall. (Point upwards)
BLUEY: Maybe their ladder was too short!
SHIFTY: (Knocks Bluey’s hat off) This is no time for funnies. We gotta get outa here or Big Tony will take over all of our operations down town. (Guard walks towards them).
GUARD: (Shouts) Are you two still yapping? (Grabs Bluey by the shoulder - pushes him around) I'll have you two up before the Warden if you keep it up. Now get in the food line and stop the talkin’. (They move along). (Guard - moves away).
